chapter_seo_title: The Snowplume Patriarch Arrives: A Primal Daoist Faces Ji Ning’s Sword-Heart
chapter_meta_description: Snowplume Daoist confronts Ji Ning over the Yan Mountain ultimatum. A divine sense duel reveals Ji Ning’s reincarnated soul, and both sides prepare for battle.
og_title: Ji Ning vs. a Thousand-Year Patriarch – The Snowplume Challenge
og_description: The Primal Daoist Snowplume arrives at Winged Serpent Lake to crush Ji Ning’s arrogance. But a clash of souls proves this teenager is no ordinary monster.
twitter_title: Ji Ning refuses to back down as a Primal Daoist descends on Winged Serpent Lake.
twitter_description: Snowplume Daoist tests Ji Ning with divine sense—and gets pushed back. Old power meets young fury in this pre-battle standoff.

lore_anchors.definition: One of the three founding patriarchs of Snowdragon Mountain, a Primal Daoist at perfection. He has cultivated for over a thousand years and wields high-grade Heaven-ranked treasures, Primordial Fire, and Celestial Water.
A rare soul-nurturing technique that weaponizes a cultivator’s divine sense into a mental shockwave, bypassing most physical defenses.
A cultivator who chose to reincarnate after death, retaining fragments of past-life memories and talents. Progresses rapidly at first but faces far worse Heartfiend Tribulations later.
A soul-based perceptual power normally unlocked at the Primal Daoist stage, allowing telekinetic control and omni-directional awareness; Ji Ning achieved this anomalously at the Wanxiang stage.
A spiritual cancer born from unresolved inner demons during a tribulation; it is far more severe for reincarnated Immortals who remember more of their past life.
The sixth major stage of Ki Refining, where the cultivator’s soul transforms into a Primal, granting divine sense and the ability to manifest clones.
The fourth major stage of Ki Refining, meaning “Myriad Manifestations.” The cultivator’s Violet Palace develops stars, moon, and sun, granting vastly faster energy absorption.
